lines.text: Day seven. Thirty-one carriages between you and the brake. One torch.
And the last carriage is sealed. From the inside.
lines.cap:
AND THE LAST ONE IS SEALED.
FROM THE INSIDE.

lines.text: To move the train again, you reset the brake by hand. At the far end. On foot.
lines.cap:
RESET THE BRAKE BY HAND.
AT THE FAR END. ON FOOT.

lines.text: Rule one. Torch at the floor, never ahead. You see legs before you see faces.
lines.cap:
RULE 1. TORCH AT THE FLOOR.
LEGS BEFORE FACES.

lines.text: So the beam stays on the floor. Carriage one. Empty.
Radio. Recovery in four days. Do not open sealed compartments.
lines.cap:
RADIO: RECOVERY IN 4 DAYS.
DO NOT OPEN SEALED DOORS.

lines.text: Rule two. One hand always empty.
Torch left. Right hand free. Carriage twelve. Twenty. Twenty-six. Empty.
Thirty-one carriages. Thirty-one empty. You checked every one this time.
Rule three. Never open a door you can't close behind you.
lines.cap:
RULE 3. NEVER OPEN A DOOR
YOU CAN'T CLOSE BEHIND YOU.

lines.text: The brake lever is outside carriage thirty-two. You don't need the door.
lines.cap:
THE LEVER IS OUTSIDE 32.
YOU DON'T NEED THE DOOR.

lines.text: Four thirty-one. Your hand is on the lever, and the knocking starts.
lines.cap:
4:31 AM. HAND ON THE LEVER.
THE KNOCKING STARTS.

lines.text: Not banging. Knocking. Three long. Three short. Three long.
lines.cap:
NOT BANGING. KNOCKING.
THREE LONG. THREE SHORT. THREE LONG.

lines.text: You know that pattern. You watched it in a mirror on day four.
The car behind you. You drove on. Their lights went out.
lines.cap:
THE CAR BEHIND YOU.
YOU DROVE ON. THEIR LIGHTS WENT OUT.

lines.text: She's been walking for three days. Following the only other thing alive.
lines.cap:
SHE'S WALKED THREE DAYS.
FOLLOWING THE ONLY OTHER THING ALIVE.

lines.text: And she sealed this door from the inside. Nobody seals a door against nothing.
lines.cap:
SHE SEALED IT FROM INSIDE.
NOBODY SEALS A DOOR AGAINST NOTHING.
